Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Soccer game injury one month prior
Comparison: [REDACTED] .

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Hyperextension mechanism contusions of the lateral tibial plateau and femoral condyle. Normal alignment No acute fracture . Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Small joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): High grade partial tear of the PCL at the mid substance.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 14 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
Grade 2 strain of the popliteus muscle. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1.	Hyperextension mechanism contusions of the lateral tibial plateau and femoral condyle with a high-grade partial rupture of the posterior cruciate ligament.
2.	Popliteus muscle grade 2 strain.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Anterior knee pain with running and jumping.
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: Moderate tendinosis with high-grade partial-thickness interstitial tearing of the proximal patella at its origin at the inferior pole of the patella. No tendon tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 14 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
Moderate proximal patellar tendinosis with interstitial tearing consistent with jumper's knee.

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Obs. Síndrome meniscal. Obs. Condromalacia.
Hallazgos:
No hay alteraciones de señal significativas de la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
Meniscos de morfología y señal conservada, sin signos de rotura.
Finas úlceras condrales focales de espesor total de la región central de la zona de carga del
cóndilo femoral medial con cambios óseos secundarios. Condropatía superficial de la región
central del platillo tibial lateral. El resto de los cartílagos femorotibiales y de la tróclea femoral sin
alteraciones. Úlceras condrales de espesor parcial y prácticamente total de la rótula de
distribución difusa de manera focal.
Mínimo aumento de señal del aspecto superoexterno de la grasa de Hoffa.
No hay derrame articular ni quistes poplíteos patológicos.
Leve engrosamiento y aumento de señal de la banda iliotibial asociado a edema las partes
blandas de predominio profundo. No hay signos de rotura fibrilar.
Tendones cuadricipital, rotuliano, tendones de la pata de ganso y bíceps femoral sin alteraciones.
Impresión:
Finas condropatía focales grado 4 de la región central del cóndilo femoral medial.
Condropatía superficial de la región central del platillo tibial lateral.
Condropatía lesiones grado 2 y 3 de la rótula de manera focal.
Discretos signos de un síndrome de hiperpresión externa de la rótula.
Signos de fricción de la banda iliotibial, correlacionar con clínica

Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication:  [REDACTED]. Left anterior knee pain after fellow cheerleader fell on the patient's left knee.  
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 T system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: Mild proximal patellar tendinosis without tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 10 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
Mild posttraumatic subcutaneous prepatellar bursitis overlying the medial patellar retinaculum, the medial aspect of the patella and proximal patellar tendon. No drainable fluid collection. No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1. No structural abnormalities at the left knee including no meniscal, ligament tear, bone contusion or fracture. No joint effusion. 
2. Mild posttraumatic subcutaneous prepatellar bursitis overlying the medial patellar retinaculum, the medial aspect of the patella and proximal patellar tendon without tears at those sites. No drainable fluid collection. 
3. Mild proximal patellar tendinosis without tear.

SOL  DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Diz eklemini oluşturan kemik yapılarda yaygın dejeneratif değişiklikler izlendi.Tibiada interkondiler eminencia düzeyinde milimetrik subkondral kistler izlendi. Tibia femoral eklemde medialde ekleme bakan yüzlerde minimal kemik iliği ödemi izlendi. Anterior çapraz bağda strein ile uyumlu minimal sinyal artışı dikkati çekti. Arka çapraz bağ, lateral ve medial kollateral ligaman normaldir.Medial menisküs posterior hornunda grade III yırtık izlendi. Anterior hornunda grade II dejenerasyon izlendi. Lateral menisküs posterior hornunda grade II dejenerasyon izlendi. Eklem mesafesinde ve suprapatellar bursada artmış effüzyon izlendi. Patella posteriorunda kıkırdak dokuda incelme ve subkondral minimal kemik iliği ödemi izlendi ( patellar kondromalazi ).Prepatellar yağ dokuda ödemli görünüm izlendi. Diz eklemine komşu yumuşak dokularda medialde dilate variköz venöz yapılar dikkati çekti.

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Síndrome meniscal medial.
Hallazgos:
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
El menisco lateral es de morfología y señal conservada, sin signos de rotura.
Rotura compleja del cuerpo y cuerno posterior del menisco medial con componente principal radial
que impresiona completo y leve separación de sus cavos.
Úlceras condrales espesor parcial y total de la zona de carga del compartimento femorotibial
medial con cambios óseos secundarios periféricos y proliferaciones óseas.
Cartílagos del compartimento femorotibial lateral sin alteraciones. Úlceras condrales espesor
parcial de la vertiente medial de la tróclea femoral y de la rótula de distribución difusa.
Leve a moderado derrame articular con sinovitis difusa. Quiste poplíteo, sin criterios categóricos
de rotura.
Tendones cuadricipital, rotuliano, tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial
dentro de límites normales.
Impresión:
Rotura compleja del menisco medial.
Condropatía lesiones grado 3 y 4 del compartimento femorotibial medial.
Condropatía lesiones grado 1 y 2 de la articulación patelofemoral.
Leve a moderado derrame articular con sinovitis difusa. Quiste poplíteo, sin criterios de
complicación

SAĞ DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Medial menisküs ve lateral menisküste grade II dejenerasyon izlenmektedir. Ön çapraz bağ , lateral ve medial kollateral ligaman normaldir. Arka çapraz bağ sinyali hafif artmış olup yer yer düzensizlikler mevcuttur (parsiyel yırtık ).Distal kuadriseps ve patellar tendonlar normaldir. Patella normal yerleşimlidir. Retinaküler devamsızlık yoktur. Patellar kıkırdakta yer yer hafif incelmeler izlendi(grade  II kondromalazi). Eklemde sıvı artışı saptanmamıştır. Diz eklemini oluşturan diğer kemik yapıların sinyal intensiteleri doğaldır. Femur medial kondil düzeyinde yaygın kemik iliği ödemi izlenmektedir. Tibiofemoral eklem düzeyde medialde eklem aralığında hafif daralma ve komşu kartilajlarda hafif incelmeler izlenmektedir. Tibia ön çapraz bağ yapışma düzeyinde subkondral milimetrik kist izlenmektedir.Tibiofibular eklem posterior kesiminde yaklaşık 27x10 mm boyutlarında lobüle konturlu ganglion kisti izlenmektedir. Impression: Partial tear of the posterior cruciate ligament. Medial compartment subchondral marrow edema and small tibial subchondral cyst. Mild patellar chondromalacia. Ganglion cyst at the proximal tibiofibular joint.

FINDINGS:

Fluid:
No significant joint effusion. No popliteal cyst.

Medial compartment (meniscus, collateral ligament, cartilage):
Moderate to severe degeneration. Diffuse partial thickness chondral loss with full-thickness chondral loss of the weightbearing portion of the compartment. Minimal associated subchondral reactive marrow change. Marginal osteophytes.
Complex multidirectional tear of the posterior horn and body of the meniscus with a dominant radial component involving the posterior root horn junction. Associated meniscal substance loss. Early flap tear with mild displacement into the tibial gutter. Mild extrusion of the body.
Medial collateral imaging is intact.

Lateral compartment (meniscus, collateral ligament complex, cartilage):
Moderate to severe degeneration.
Diffuse high-grade partial-thickness chondral loss with no full-thickness component. Marginal osteophytosis.
Complex multidirectional tear of the posterior horn and body of the meniscus with a horizontal oblique longitudinal components and meniscal substance loss. Mild meniscal extrusion.
The lateral collateral ligament complex is intact.

Intercondylar compartment (anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments):
The ACL and PCL are intact.

Anterior compartment (extensor mechanism, cartilage, Hoffa's fat pad):
Moderate to severe degeneration.
Full thickness chondral loss of the inferior aspect of the lateral and medial facets with subchondral reactive marrow change, full-thickness chondral loss of the lateral facet of the trochlea, and diffuse high-grade partial thickness chondral loss of the medial facet.
Marginal osteophytosis. Mild edema of the suprapatellar fat pad.

Bones:
See above.

Muscles and neurovascular structures:
Normal.

Other findings:
Small ganglion cyst seen posterior to the PCL measuring up to 7 mm.

CONCLUSION:
1.Moderate to severe tricompartmental degenerative disease.
2.Complex multidirectional tear of the posterior horn and body of the medial meniscus with a dominant radial component involving the posterior root horn junction. Associated meniscal substance loss. Early flap tear with mild displacement into the tibial gutter.
3.Complex multidirectional tear of the posterior horn and body of the lateral meniscus with a horizontal oblique longitudinal components and meniscal substance loss. Mild meniscal extrusion.
